disclosure: I'm Mukwano, an automated helper. I'm not a person, but a real person can help you too.
helpline_line: You can call {helpline} to talk with a real person.
no_helpline_line: Please ask an adult you trust who is near you to help you now.
no_helpline_line_short: Ask a trusted adult near you to help now.
external_only_note: Because this involves someone close to you, I won't share this with your family or school.
external_only_note_short: We won't tell your family or school.
clarify: Can you tell me a little more about what happened? You can skip anything you don't want to say.
clarify_short: Tell me more if you like.

safe_actions.text: Stop replying to the person for now.
Do not send money, airtime or more photos.
Do not delete the messages. They can help stop this person.

path_options.label: Make a report. You choose who is told
Learn how to keep proof safely

self_harm.reply: I'm really glad you told me. You matter, and you don't have to carry this alone. Please go to an adult you trust right now, or reach a real person who can talk with you.
self_harm.short: You matter. Tell a trusted adult now or reach a person who can help.

immediate_danger.reply: Your safety comes first. If you can, move to a safe place near other people and ask an adult close by for help right now. You did the right thing by telling me.
immediate_danger.short: Get to a safe place near people and ask an adult for help now.

abuse.reply: Thank you for telling me. What you described is not okay, and it is not your fault. You deserve to be safe. A trained person can help you. If your life is in danger, a trained person may need to act to keep you safe, and they will tell you.
abuse.short: Not your fault. You deserve to be safe. A trained person can help you.

sextortion.reply: This is not your fault. What this person is doing is wrong, and many young people have been through it. Please don't reply, don't send money or more photos, and don't delete the messages. You choose what happens next, and a trained person can help.
sextortion.short: Not your fault. Don't reply, don't pay, keep the messages.

grooming.reply: Thank you for telling me. An adult asking a child for photos or secrets is not okay, and it is not your fault. You can stop replying and keep the messages. You choose what happens next.
grooming.short: Not your fault. Stop replying and keep the messages. You choose what happens next.

harassment.reply: I'm sorry this is happening. You did nothing wrong. You can block the person, keep screenshots, and talk to someone you trust. I can explain your options when you are ready.
harassment.short: Sorry this happened. Block them, keep screenshots, tell someone you trust.

account_scam.reply: Thanks for telling me. Please don't send money or share passwords. Keep the messages, and tell an adult you trust. I can explain how to make your account safe again.
account_scam.short: Don't send money or share passwords. Keep the messages.

exposure.reply: Thank you for telling me. Seeing something upsetting online is not your fault. You can close it, and talk to an adult you trust if you want. I can explain how to report it.
exposure.short: Not your fault. Close it and tell a trusted adult if you want.

other.reply: Thank you for reaching out. I'm here to listen, and you can share as much or as little as you want.
other.short: I'm here. Tell me what happened, as much as you like.

welcome.long: Hello, I'm Mukwano, an automated helper. A real person can help too. You choose what happens next. What would you like to talk about?
welcome.short: Habari auto-reply: Tell me what happened. You choose what happens next.

ask_who.long: Who is doing this? You can choose the last option if you would rather not say.

offer.long: What would you like to do next? You can choose anything, or nothing.

ask_question.long: What would you like to know? Ask in your own words.

no_answer.long: I don't have an answer for that, but a trained person can help.
no_answer.short: No answer found. A trained person can help.

safe_actions_title.long: Three things that keep you safe

report_intro.long: Here is what I would pass on. Nothing is sent unless you say yes.
report_intro.short: Nothing is sent unless you say yes.

report_who_external.long: A trained person outside your home and school will read this. We will not tell your family or school.
report_who_external.short: Only a trained person outside home and school sees it.

report_who_default.long: A trained person will read this and talk with you first. Family or school are told only if you agree.
report_who_default.short: A trained person reads it first. Family or school only if you agree.

report_who_serious.long: Because this is serious, a trained person may bring in a child protection partner. They will explain before anything happens.
report_who_serious.short: Serious cases may involve child protection. We explain first.

report_confirm.long: Do you want me to prepare this report?

report_ready.long: Thank you for telling me. Your report is ready. You did the right thing.
report_ready.short: Report ready. You did the right thing.

edit_prompt.long: What would you like to add? I will add it to your report.

external_notice.long: Because this involves someone close to you, I won't share this with your family or school.
external_notice.short: We won't tell your family or school.

danger_safe.long: I'm glad you are safe right now. A real person can still help you. What would you like to do next?
danger_safe.short: Glad you're safe. A person can still help. What next?

danger_unsafe.long: Please move to a safe place near other people and ask an adult close by to help you now.
danger_unsafe.short: Move near other people and ask an adult for help now.

please_choose.long: Please choose one of the options.
please_choose.short: Reply with a number from the list.

closing.long: Take care of yourself. You can come back any time.
closing.short: Take care. You can come back any time.

ask_feeling.long: How does this feel for you right now? There is no wrong answer.

feeling_higher.long: I know it may feel small. Because of what you told me, I want a trained person to be able to help you.
feeling_higher.short: It may feel small, but a trained person should be able to help.

unknown.label: I don't know, or I'd rather not say

feel_scared.label: I'm scared or I feel unsafe

sextortion.label: Someone threatening to share your pictures

grooming.label: An adult asking for photos or secrets
